sourceSummary.zh: 韦博利用税务公开数据计算两级利得税的财政代价，并从同类收入税负不一致的角度，主张取消这项优惠。
sourceSummary.en: Webb uses tax data to estimate the fiscal cost of two-tier profits tax and argues for abolition through the unequal treatment of comparable income.

paragraphs.zh: 这篇文章的起点是税务局公开数据。韦博把两级税制减收金额与利得税收入放在一起比较，指出优惠不是抽象的扶持口号，而是一项有持续财政成本的安排。他随后追问：这些减收是否带来了可以证明的新增经济活动？文章的论证因此有两个层次——支出规模可以计算，政策收益则需要另找证据。
paragraphs.en: Webb starts with Inland Revenue Department data, comparing revenue forgone with profits-tax receipts. The concession has a continuing fiscal cost. He then asks whether demonstrable additional economic activity offsets it. His argument separates a measurable fiscal cost from a claimed policy benefit that requires its own evidence.

heading.zh: 两级税率为什么让他质疑公平
heading.en: Why the rate structure raises a fairness question

paragraphs.zh: 他列出公司标准税率为 16.5%，首 200 万港元利润适用 8.25% 的安排。接下来，他把公司股东兼董事可以调整薪酬与公司利润分配的情形，与领取工资者所面对的税率比较。问题在于，相近的劳动或经营收入，可能因为使用不同组织形式而承担不同税负；文章针对的是这种制度差异，而不只是税率高低。
paragraphs.en: He contrasts the standard corporate rate of 16.5% with 8.25% on the first HK$2 million of profit. He then compares an owner-director’s ability to adjust salary and corporate profit with the tax treatment of wage earners. His objection concerns different burdens on comparable income arising from organizational form, beyond the absolute level of any single rate.

heading.zh: 他的主张与数字怎样衔接
heading.en: Connecting the calculation with his proposal

paragraphs.zh: 韦博主张取消两级优惠，并按文章使用的年度数据估计，可增加约 65 亿港元税收。他的理由不是企业不重要，而是没有看到足以支持这种区别待遇的政策收益。阅读时最值得跟进的是这条推理：公开数据确定财政代价，再检验优惠的受益对象和效果，最后比较同类纳税人的待遇。这也体现了他一贯用具体制度与数字讨论公共资源分配的方式。
paragraphs.en: He proposes abolishing the concession and estimates approximately HK$6.5 billion of additional annual revenue using the data discussed in the article. His case rests on an absence of demonstrated benefits sufficient to justify unequal treatment. The argument moves from fiscal data to beneficiaries and effects, then to comparable taxpayers. It exemplifies his use of specific rules and numbers to examine public-resource allocation.
